**Building and city**

**Contribution ZIP**
Attach the package downloaded from Landmarks in Lumen Streets.

**References**
Link sources for the height, silhouette and position. Include a daytime or nighttime reference when available.

**Authorship and license**
State who made the model and which license applies. Disclose any third-party geometry and its license.

**Placement notes**
Mention any existing map buildings that the model should replace, and any separate annexes that should remain.
